The official Amazon Black Friday Week is now soaring with Apple deals, including AirPods Pro 3 at $70 off, the latest 2026 AirPods Max 2 now at $120 off, and loads of MacBook deals – MacBook Neo down at $649, the first price drops on the M6 MacBook Pro and PROLED XDR MacBook Pro at up to $250 off, and the most affordable M5 MacBook Air at $250 off. Those offers join the lowest prices ever on Apple Watch Series 12, new all-time lows on the most affordable Apple Studio Displays at $200 off, and a giant deal on the new Beats 360 modular ANC headphones are now $100 off (lowest price ever). All of that, the best deal yet on the popular Twelve South AirFly Drive Wireless CarPlay Adapter, and much more await below.
